why: 🔴 [grundtone]'s three provoked holes, 2026-10-22. v2 answered "passed", exit 0, on all three.

cells.label: (a) secrets: inherit without environment
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  call:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml
    secrets: inherit

cells.label: (a) secrets: inherit WITH environment is not flagged
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  call:
    environment:
      name: x
    uses: ./x.yml
    secrets: inherit

cells.label: (b) secrets['NAME'] bracket form is seen
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets['LEAKY_KEY'] }}

cells.label: (b) bracket form with double quotes
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets["LEAKY_KEY"] }}

cells.label: (b) bracket form inside a gated job is fine
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    environment:
      name: x
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets['K'] }}

cells.label: (c) toJSON(secrets) -> instrument, not a pass
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    env:
      ALL: ${{ toJSON(secrets) }}

cells.label: (c) an unknown form is loud even next to a known one
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    env:
      ALL: ${{ toJSON(secrets) }}

why: 🔴 The regression that the synthetic fixtures could not show: prose is not a reference.

cells.label: a step NAME mentioning deploy-secrets is not a reference
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - name: Assert that deploy-secrets exist (fail-loud)
        run: echo ok

cells.label: prose plus a real reference still reports the reference
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - name: check deploy-secrets
        env:
          K: ${{ secrets.MY_KEY }}

cells.label: explicit secrets: mapping is structural, not unknown
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  call:
    environment:
      name: x
    uses: ./x.yml
    secrets:
      INNER: ${{ secrets.MY_KEY }}

why: 🔴 [grundtone]'s fourth fixture: an expression folded across two lines. v3 said "passed".

cells.label: (d) ${{ opened on one line, closed on the next
(d) folded expression inside a gated job is fine
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    environment:
      name: x
    env:
      K: ${{
        secrets.MY_KEY }}

cells.label: (d) an UNCLOSED ${{ must not let the fold eat job keys
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets.MY_KEY
  b:
    env:
      L: ${{ secrets.OTHER }}

why: [grundtone]'s own negative control: a reusable workflow DECLARES the secrets it accepts under `on: workflow_call:`. A declaration is not a consumption and must not be counted as one.

cells.label: workflow_call secret DECLARATION is not consumption
cells.workflow:
on:
  workflow_call:
    secrets:
      DEPLOY_KEY:
        required: true
jobs:
  a:
    environment:
      name: x
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}

why: 🔴 Cursor Bugbot's review of #291, 2026-10-26: five shapes that v4 answered GREEN. Each cell is the shape that passed; every one was provoked against v4 before it was fixed.

cells.label: Bugbot: a step input named environment: is not the gate
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - uses: x/y@v1
        with:
          environment: prod
        env:
          K: ${{ secrets.LEAKY_KEY }}

cells.label: Bugbot: a matrix key named environment: is not the gate
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        environment: [a, b]
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets.LEAKY_KEY }}

cells.label: Bugbot: a job key with an inline comment starts its own job
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    environment: prod
  b: # deploy job
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets.LEAKY_KEY }}

cells.label: an unknown line at job indentation -> instrument, not guessed
Bugbot: an environment with no branch policy gates nothing
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    environment: copilot
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets.LEAKY_KEY }}

cells.label: an environment named by an expression cannot be confirmed
Bugbot: secrets: inherit with an inline comment is still inherit
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  call:
    uses: ./x.yml
    secrets: inherit # all of them

cells.label: Bugbot (#293): environment: "" is no environment
cells.workflow:
jobs:
  a:
    environment: ""
    env:
      K: ${{ secrets.LEAKY_KEY }}

cells.label: Bugbot (#293): environment: { name: '' } is no environment
